title: Trump accused of falling asleep during Xi Jinping speech at Apec summit in China
summary_full: US president appeared to doze off while Chinese leader made speech, but White House insisted he was awakeDonald Trump was, again, accused of falling asleep during a televised event, this time during the speech of the Chinese president, Xi Jinping, at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit in China.The US president appeared to close his eyes for roughly 10 seconds on Thursday. As his eyes closed, Trump’s head tilted downward, and his hands remained clasped in front of him. Continue reading...
